title: Slip joint connections.
officialText: Slip joints shall be made with an approved elastomeric gasket and shall only be installed on the trap outlet, trap inlet and within the trap seal. Fixtures with concealed slip-joint connections shall be provided with an access panel or utility space at least 12 inches (305mm) in its smallest dimension or other approved arrangement so as to provide access to the slip joint connections for inspection and repair.
